collector_hosted_intake_acceptance_root_.observed_shape: source-ingest-scheduler hit consecutive_controller_failures=3 (stage=controller, TimeoutError: timed out) during post-recreate startup ticks while source-ingest held source_execution_lock in a social collector pull scanning normalized/tw_price_daily run files (PTT ingest-016f8ba0dac0 515s, Threads ingest-a565e7c08dd7 486s on Root 45124155084 / Root 45135463208 under COLLECTOR-HOSTED-INTAKE-ACCEPTANCE-20261113).

reasons: PR #7769 (COLLECTOR-SOCIAL-STEADY-AUTHORITY-20261123) only skipped CollectorBundleAdapter._instrument_authority() when a social pull returned zero items or only venue-qualified symbols (needs_authority == False). On Root 46095941360, ingest-4731e8b6a075 (collector-tw-cmoney-forum) pulled 9 social posts containing bare tickers (needs_authority == True), triggering stored_instrument_authority() twice across all 8,881 normalized/tw_price_daily run files (15 GB x 2 = 30 GB read, 435.0s).

PR #7769 did not address the cold-start GET /api/source-ingest/controller/readback cost: PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository had 44,066 source_record rows in Postgres (len(_source_records_by_tenant) == 44,066) but 44,064 distinct unscoped source_ids (len(_source_records) == 44,064 due to 2 tenanted+legacy source_id collisions), so _sync_and_list_source_records() saw len(repo._source_records) != db_count and re-fetched and deserialized all 44,066 rows on the first readback after startup (37.527s under stack recreate load, exceeding the 30.0s readback timeout on its own).

CollectorBundleAdapter._instrument_authority() -> stored_instrument_authority() when social posts contain bare tickers: before fix scanned all 8,881 normalized/tw_price_daily/date=*/*.jsonl* run files (15 GB across 498 dates) TWICE (self._raw_root() and SOURCE_INGEST_MARKET_DATA_STORAGE_ROOT, both /data/source-ingest/market_data_store = 17,762 file reads / 30 GB, taking 435.0s under runtime.source_execution_lock while Ticks 1, 2, and 3 timed out at 65.6s and failed at stage='controller')

requests_exceeding_controller_timeout.why: Tick 1 started ingest-4731e8b6a075 (collector-tw-cmoney-forum, 9 posts with bare tickers) at 02:43:16Z under runtime.source_execution_lock; stored_instrument_authority scanned 8,881 tw_price_daily run files twice (435.0s), causing Tick 1 (02:44:21Z), Tick 2 (02:46:35Z), and Tick 3 (02:48:48Z) to time out at 65.6s and wrap TimeoutError as ControllerTickError('controller', 'TimeoutError: timed out').

On the first readback after source-ingest startup, _sync_and_list_source_records() compared len(repo._source_records) (44,064 distinct source_ids) == db_count (44,066 Postgres rows with 2 tenanted+legacy collisions), which was always False, triggering a full 44,066-row SELECT and JSON deserialization during the request (37.527s during stack recreate at 04:04:38Z..04:05:15Z, exceeding the 30.0s timeout).

fixes: services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: _sync_and_list_source_records() recognizes PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository as initialized when len(repo._source_records) == db_count OR len(repo._source_records_by_tenant) == db_count, eliminating the 44,066-row cold re-fetch and deserialization on the first readback; caches the records tuple when unchanged.

services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: _latest_source_record_by_connector() caches the full connector map without target_cids in the cache key and filters on return, so GET /api/source-ingest/registry is an O(1) cache hit and never invalidates controller/readback's cache.

services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: _controller_connector_readbacks() and _controller_readback_payload() use _grouped_freshness_snapshot() with _preordered_receipts=True and _precomputed_latest_run, and _dlq_readback_summary() caches the 7,620-entry DLQ aggregation when unchanged.

services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: _StatCachedConnectorScheduleStore stat-caches connector_schedule.jsonl so reconcile does not re-parse 434 lines ~120 times per request; _fast_resolve_pending_dlq_for_completed_frontiers queries store.list_frontier(status='done') once per tick instead of 7,528 store.get_frontier() lock acquisitions.

services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: _cached_stored_instrument_authority deduplicates roots, uses DailyBarsReader (_daily_bars_symbols) for normalized/tw_price_daily dates covered by up-to-date daily_bars manifests (486/498 dates on hosted dev), caches per-file symbols by (path, st_ino, st_mtime_ns, st_size) for uncovered dates, and caches per-root authority snapshots.

services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: SourceIngestionRuntime.__init__() warms controller readback and instrument authority in _warm_controller_readback() before setting controller_readback_ready=True; /readyz reports 503 (reason='controller_readback_warming') until warm-up finishes.

services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py & controller_state.py: run_controller_loop() and next_tick_sleep_seconds() execute at most one immediate catch-up tick (tick == 1) when startup_missed_ticks > 1 and pace remaining missed ticks at the full normal cadence (interval_seconds).
